verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents a host-side view of currently connected peers, or a control to disconnect or revoke a device from the host. Server Pro's audit logs, web console and per-user/device-group access control are adjacent admin features, not a live on-host connection view with disconnect or revoke.

support.subject: As a power user, the host shows who is connected right now, and I can disconnect or revoke a device from the host
